doc.title: Anat Cohen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2021

title: New albums: Quartetinho and Reconvexo with Marcello Goncalves
summary: She is recording with Quartetinho and has an album of Brazilian songs, Reconvexo, coming next month.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And there’s a new album coming out. We’re going to be recording with Quartetinho with a small band at the end of this month. I know we’re in September 2021 now but we’ll be recording so it will come out next year. But also next month I have a new album coming out with Marcello Goncalves. So that’s what happens when you spend the pandemic, you have time to work on music and record and it’s a reflection of the year of work and the
album is called “Reconvexo” which is a song by Caetano Veloso and it has a lot of singer-songwriter songs from Brazil. So I’m excited about that.
